title: QA-01 Quality
summary: QA-01 is Northbridge's open Quality cost centre under unit NBC-MAN-01 and owner PJANSEN, with £81,817.95 available budget in 2026-Q4.
body:
Cost centre QA-01 covers the Quality department at Northbridge Cycles within operational unit NBC-MAN-01 [^r1]. Its record is OPEN under cost centre owner PJANSEN [^r1]. For 2026-Q4 as of 26 October 2026 09:00, the cost centre holds an allocated budget of £116,000, against which £34,182.05 has been committed and £81,817.95 remains available [^r2].

## Budget and spending

Budget and commitment tracking for QA-01 is maintained in [[data-cost-centres-and-budgets|Cost Centres and Budgets FY2026-27]] [^r1][^r2]. For the fourth quarter of 2026 (2026-Q4), financial figures recorded as of 26 October 2026 09:00 stand at:

| Period | Budget amount | Committed spend | Available budget |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-Q4 | £116,000 | £34,182.05 | £81,817.95 |

All figures derive from sheet Budgets 2026-Q4 [^r2].
